project.name: Primitive
release_notes: Plunk send requests can carry typed file attachments as documented filename, contentType and base64 content objects; absent attachments preserve the previous wire shape.

Attachment admission bounds count, individual and aggregate bytes, safe UTF-8 file names and native MIME grammar. Exact limit and semantic base64 round-trip proof is retained, with a deliberate omitted-member control.
This release adds SDK attachment transport only; provider delivery, inbox rendering and calendar import require independent application evidence.
